contract_facts: CMake requires explicit YOLOV5_TARGET and never reads board sysfs.
X5 requires exactly one packed model, one input, three distinct metadata heads, F32 outputs, and 3*(5+classes) channels.
S keeps HB-DNN model discovery and UCP scheduling in a separate adapter; caller priority is preserved and source S32/per-channel dequantization is delegated to dequantizeTensorS32.
Both adapters match heads by actual metadata stride and reject duplicate or incomplete head sets.
External model paths require the exact manifest asset ID and launcher target identity is checked before native execution.
X5 native preprocessing retains source letterbox semantics while unified Python defaults to stretch; S native preprocessing retains letterbox.
